veranderings.blok: Twee maniere om dieselfde ding te sê
veranderings.voor: Die woordskaal is maklik om te lees en die lynskaal
veranderings.na: Die woordskaal is maklik om te lees, en die lynskaal
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two full sentences, each with its own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it.

veranderings.blok: Twee maniere om dieselfde ding te sê
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'Albei kan ... staan' and 'baie kaarte dra ...' each have their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before 'en'.

veranderings.blok: Twee maniere om dieselfde ding te sê
veranderings.rede: 'Dra net een van die twee' reads stiff for a map having only one of the two scales; 'het' is the natural Grade 6 word, and the next block's heading and closing sentence keep 'dra'.

veranderings.voor: Sy stukkies word korter of langer
veranderings.na: Die stukke word korter of langer
veranderings.rede: Sentence-initial 'Sy' can read as 'she', and 'stukkies' differs from 'stukke' used for the same parts in the lynskaal block and the glossary.
